summary.text: Bruce Bannister is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 24, having assumed office in 2004, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He is an attorney, and the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Bannister earned a B.A. from Davidson College in 1995 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1998.
He is managing partner of Bannister and Wyatt, LLC, and is an attorney, according to Ballotpedia.
Bannister chaired the House Ways and Means Committee in the 2023-2024 session and is assigned to that committee in the 2025-2026 session.
